title: F16 — UI finish and App Store
tagline: take every screen from the ~30% skeleton to Figma, on real logic, then ship to the App Store.
intro: F16 · 48h · skeleton guide — last feature; filled in when it starts.

blocks.html:
• Goal: take every screen from the ~30% skeleton to Figma, on real logic, then ship to the App Store.
  • Demo: every screen matches Figma side by side in light and dark mode; the build is submitted for review.
  • Specs: Design plan, mockups, Figma file
  • Starting point: every screen on real logic (F00–F15), still at the ~30% skeleton look with placeholders.
  • Status: skeleton — parts, files, order, tests. Filled in when this feature starts.
  • File tags: Edit change only the part shown.

Order
  • F16 changes how screens look, never what they do.
  • Step 1 first: every screen step uses the finished components.
  • Steps 2–7 in any order; 8 after them; 9 closes the roadmap.

blocks.html:
StepDo
1Open the Figma frame and the running screen side by side
2Fix spacing, sizes, fonts with tokens only (SDSpacing, SDFont…); add a token if Figma needs a new value
3Swap placeholders and native controls for the designed ones
4Check light + dark, small (SE) and large (Pro Max) iPhone, largest Dynamic Type
5Record or update the snapshot test, commit per screen
